über die rolle

Als B2B Operations Manager entwickelst du die Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsweisen unseres B2B-Bereichs. Du nutzt Daten, Automatisierung und KI, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und Abläufe skalierbar zu machen. So kann sich das Team stärker auf Kunden, Partnerschaften und Wachstum konzentrieren.

Unser CRM befindet sich im finalen Aufbau. Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung dafür, wie B2B-Prozesse im CRM abgebildet werden: Du erkennst Engpässe in der Datenpflege und den Workflows, formulierst Anforderungen an Struktur und Automatisierung und setzt neue Abläufe gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams um - von der Abbildung von Lead-Qualifizierung und Onboarding über Pricing- und Konditionslogik bis zu Partnerkommunikation und Shop-Prozessen.

deine aufgaben

B2B-Prozesse & Operations (ca. 60%)

  • Du übernimmst 0-to-1-Ownership für unsere B2B-Prozesse, von der Lead-Qualifizierung über das Onboarding bis zur laufenden Partnerbetreuung. Wo heute kein sauberer Ablauf existiert, baust du einen.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu CRM und Automation: Du verstehst die Datenflüsse, erkennst Engpässe und formulierst klare Anforderungen, die Data & AI und IT technisch umsetzen. CRM-Hygiene ist für dich die Grundlage jeder verlässlichen Auswertung.
  • Du verbindest Sales, Supply Chain, Finance und Product zu reibungslosen Abläufen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran.
  • Du definierst und trackst zentrale KPIs (Conversion Rate, Pipeline-Geschwindigkeit, Lead-Qualität, Customer Value) und baust Reporting, das dem Team echte Steuerungsintelligenz gibt, keine Zahlenfriedhöfe.
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert: Du machst Best Practices zu Playbooks und SOPs und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Team wirklich genutzt werden.
Operatives Enabling (ca. 40%)
  • Du verantwortest B2B-Newsletter und Partner-Kommunikation: Du bringst die richtigen Aktionen zu den richtigen Partnergruppen und wertest ihre Wirkung aus (Open Rate, CTR, Conversion).
  • Du entwickelst unsere Pricing- und Konditionenlogik mit und pflegst sie sauber in Shop und CRM: kommerziell durchdacht, konsistent, nachvollziehbar.
  • Du betreust unseren B2B-Shop und den Education-Shop: Produktzugänge, Kollektionen, Bundles, kleinere Anpassungen, und du begleitest die Shop-Migration.
  • Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich.

dein profil

  • Du hast 3-4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Sales-Organisation, Commercial/Sales Operations, Strategieberatung oder einem Scale-up gesammelt. Ein Hintergrund in einer Strategieberatung oder Business Development ist ein Pluspunkt.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit HubSpot und bewegst dich sicher in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Workflows.
  • Du bist ein hands-on Generalist: Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, setzt selbst um statt zu delegieren, und dir ist keine Aufgabe zu klein.
  • Du hast bereits komplexe, bereichsübergreifende Projekte eigenständig geführt - von Scoping und Business Case über die Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Team (SOPs, Playbooks, Trainings).
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du erkennst Chancen, priorisierst nach Wirkung und Skalierbarkeit und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du arbeitest stark analytisch: Du bewegst dich sicher in großen Datenmengen und Spreadsheets und ziehst daraus klare, umsetzbare Schlüsse.
  • Du hast eine hohe KI- und Datenaffinität: Du hast KI-Tools bereits praktisch in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt und möchtest sie zu einem festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise machen. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und lernst schnell.
  • Du strukturierst fachliche Bedarfe und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Anforderungen an Prozesse, Daten und Systeme. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und zielgruppengerecht innerhalb des Unternehmens.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.

was uns wichtig ist

  • Stapelstein ist für dich kein Job - sondern eine Mission, hinter der du wirklich stehst.
  • Für dich ist ein respektvoller, empathischer Umgang keine Checkbox - sondern die Basis, auf der gute Zusammenarbeit entsteht.
  • Herausforderungen bremsen dich nicht - sie machen dich neugierig.
  • Du denkst kreativ und unternehmerisch - du findest Wege, wo andere Hindernisse sehen, und machst dich in deinen Rollen wirklich wirkungsvoll.
  • Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung und triffst Entscheidungen mit Überzeugung - ohne dass jemand fragen muss.
  • Du brauchst keine Struktur von außen - du schaffst sie dir selbst.
  • Du nutzt KI nicht, weil es alle tun - sondern weil du verstanden hast, dass es die Art, wie wir arbeiten, grundlegend verändert.

was wir bieten

  • Der Start ist jederzeit möglich.
  • Ein marktübliches, faires Gehaltspaket.
  • Remote-first - in Deutschland und zeitweise auch aus dem Ausland.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer gemeinsamen Kernzeit von 9-12 Uhr.
  • Überstunden werden vollständig durch Freizeitausgleich ausgeglichen.
  • Vollzeit bedeutet bei uns 36 Stunden pro Woche - für mehr Fokus und mehr Lebenszeit. Ergänzt wird das durch 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.
  • Monatliche Team-Meet-ups in Stuttgart oder Berlin. Zeit, um gemeinsam im selben Raum zu arbeiten, Projekte voranzubringen und sich persönlich auszutauschen.
  • Zwei inspirierende Offsites pro Jahr, weil echtes Teamgefühl trotz Remote-first seinen Raum braucht.
  • Flexible Benefits wie Einkaufsbudget, Mobilitätszuschuss oder Urban Sports - nach bestandener Probezeit.

Faites croître vos revenus. Concluez des affaires lucratives. Bâtissez votre carrière.

Si vous êtes un professionnel des ventes motivé qui veut que vos revenus reflètent votre performance, Vision33 vous offre l'occasion de bâtir une carrière en vente très enrichissante.

Alors que la demande continue de croître, nous élargissons notre équipe de vente — et nous recherchons un représentant du développement des ventes (SDR) bilingue motivé, prêt à contribuer à une pratique SAP Business One établie et dynamique.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients potentiels pour comprendre leurs besoins, leur présenter la valeur des services gérés de SAP Business One et Vision33, et les guider vers une solution qui fait vraiment une différence.

En tant que nouveau rôle au sein de notre équipe de vente, cela vous donne la chance d'avoir un impact immédiat et d'y laisser vraiment votre empreinte. Vous aurez l'occasion de gagner des incitatifs mensuels, avec une opportunité d'accélérateur, basés sur les KPI cibles du poste. Vous serez soutenu par une équipe de direction et de vente forte et expérimentée, où la collaboration et la motivation seront essentielles à votre succès.

  • Soutenez l'équipe des ventes en utilisant les données, en collaborant avec les équipes internes et en établissant des occasions de vente.
  • Assistez à des événements et réseautez : À bien des égards, vous serez le visage de SAP Business One chez Vision33. Vous allez réseauter avec des professionnels de l'industrie et bâtir un pipeline qui crée des prospects de vente précieux. Assister à des événements et des conférences sera obligatoire – ce qui signifie que certains déplacements locaux sont essentiels pour réussir dans ce rôle. 

Ce que vous apporterez :

  • Compétences interpersonnelles : Vous êtes un communicateur naturel avec de solides aptitudes interpersonnelles et un état d'esprit positif axé sur le client.

Vous cherchez des personnes axées sur la vente, enthousiastes, énergiques, motivées et un désir inlassable de faire progresser votre carrière professionnelle en vente. Diplômé avec au moins 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en vente. L'expérience en B2B, marketing numérique ou SaaS est un plus. 
  • Il faut être bilingue en français (compétence minimale en conversation) et en anglais.

  • Tech-Savvy : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la suite Microsoft Office, vous apprenez rapidement de nouveaux logiciels et vous avez le désir de vendre des technologies de pointe.

raw.title: Senior Developer, Backend - Developer Infrastructure
raw.excerpt: About FullscriptWe’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better.
raw.description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
Fullscript is looking for an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to join the infrastructure team responsible for the long-term health, scalability, and developer experience of Fullscript’s core application.

Our team enables fast, reliable product development by defining and upholding engineering standards for quality, scalability, and maintainability. We take on foundational upgrades, cross-team technical work, and infrastructure projects that help product teams move quickly without compromising the stability of the platform.

Our team cares about doing things well. That means improving the systems developers work in every day, reducing friction, modernizing our stack, and making thoughtful technical decisions that support Fullscript’s long-term growth.
This is how we like building software:. If you share our values, we’d be excited to talk with you!

What you'll do

  • Own and improve the long-term technical health of our monorepo
  • Plan out solution designs and release strategies in collaboration with other engineering teams and stakeholders
  • Lead foundational upgrades across the stack
  • Improve code quality, application structure, maintainability, and engineering standards
  • Address scalability, reliability, and performance concerns as the product grows
  • Resolve security vulnerabilities across the application and its dependencies
  • Build and maintain shared developer tooling, CI linting, and quality-of-life improvements
  • Maintain and evolve shared infrastructure such as feature flags, end-to-end tests, and infrastructure-as-code within the monolith
  • Support product teams by solving cross-cutting technical issues
  • Act as a multiplier by unblocking other teams and improving the systems they rely on
  • Contribute through implementation, code review, technical guidance, mentorship, and documentation

What you bring to the table

  • Strong experience with Ruby or Ruby on Rails
  • You are a passionate software engineer who cares about your craft and serving other developers as your end users.
  • You are excited to learn, lead projects and want to produce the best work possible.
  • Experience designing maintainable systems and making pragmatic technical tradeoffs
  • Strong testing habits and an understanding of how tests support long-term maintainability
  • Comfort working on platform, infrastructure, tooling, or developer experience problems
  • A desire to improve engineering standards across teams
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering teams
  • A willingness to learn, ask questions, and receive feedback

Bonus if you have

  • Experience scaling or working on high-scale web applications
  • Past experience working in e-commerce or health tech sector
  • You’ve worked with React or GraphQL in the past
  • Experience improving CI systems, test suites, feature flag systems, or developer tooling

What we can offer you

  • Generous PTO and competitive pay
  • Fullscript’s RRSP match program for financial health
  • Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program
  • Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives
  • Discount on Fullscript catalog of products
  • Ability to work Wherever You Work Well*
    • *Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office — whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🏡

Compensation range

The salary range for this role is between $125,000 and $165,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only and does not include stock options, wellness stipends, or other benefits that are part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.
Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.
Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at .
All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.
We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Oracle PL/SQL Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise database solutions supporting high-volume transactional systems, financial applications, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical business operations. This role focuses on building scalable PL/SQL applications, optimizing complex SQL queries, developing database objects, and ensuring high availability and performance across large Oracle environments.
You will work closely with application developers, database administrators, data architects, QA engineers, and business analysts to build efficient database solutions that support enterprise applications, cloud modernization initiatives, and data integration platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Oracle Database technologies, advanced PL/SQL programming, query optimization, and performance tuning while maintaining high standards for data integrity, security, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects supporting enterprise applications.
  • Develop highly optimized SQL queries for large transactional and analytical databases.
  • Design scalable database schemas, indexing strategies, partitioning models, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Build ETL processes and database integration components for enterprise data movement and synchronization.
  • Develop batch processing jobs and automated database workflows supporting business-critical operations.
  • Analyze execution plans, identify SQL bottlenecks, and optimize database performance for high-volume systems.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to design efficient database access patterns and API integrations.
  • Implement database security, auditing, role-based access controls, and data encryption standards.
  • Develop database migration scripts, deployment packages, and release automation processes.
  • Perform database code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and resolve complex data integrity problems.
  • Support database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure, or AWS.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, architecture reviews, and production support rotations.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional experience developing enterprise Oracle database solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL including packages, stored procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, collections, exceptions, and dynamic SQL.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with complex joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), analytical functions, window functions, and query optimization.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle Database 12c, 19c, or newer enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle indexing, partitioning, materialized views, execution plans, and optimizer statistics.
  • Experience optimizing high-volume OLTP and OLAP database workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL*Plus, or similar Oracle development tools.
  • Experience developing ETL processes and integrating Oracle databases with external systems.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, RMAN, and database migration methodologies.
  • Experience working with Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ), Scheduler, and database jobs.
  • Experience integrating Oracle databases with Java, .NET, Python, or REST-based enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of database normalization, data modeling, and relational database design principles.
  • Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines for database deployment automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Database Services or Autonomous Database.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Exadata, RAC (Real Application Clusters), and Data Guard environments.
  • Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Oracle SOA Suite.
  • Knowledge of Oracle APEX application development.
  • Experience developing financial, healthcare, insurance, retail, or government enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud migration strategies from on-premises Oracle databases to OCI, Azure, or AWS.
  • Experience with shell scripting, Python, or PowerShell for database automation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts.
  • Oracle Database Administration or Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certifications are highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated environments requiring auditability, compliance, and data governance.

Project Environment
You will be joining an enterprise data engineering and application modernization team responsible for supporting mission-critical Oracle database platforms serving multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise financial transaction processing systems
  • Healthcare claims and patient management platforms
  • Insurance policy administration and billing systems
  • Large-scale ERP and supply chain applications
  • Cloud migration of Oracle databases to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data platforms
  • Enterprise data integration and batch processing solutions
  • High-availability Oracle environments supporting millions of daily transactions
  • Performance optimization and modernization of legacy PL/SQL applications
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to database architecture, PL/SQL development, SQL optimization, cloud migration, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise Oracle platforms.

We’re seeking a Business Development Representative who will help build pipeline for Fresche Analytics, connecting organizations with solutions that improve reporting, financial visibility, business intelligence, and data-driven decision-making.

Fresche Solutions helps organizations modernize their applications, data, and technology environments. Through Fresche Analytics, we help clients unlock greater value from their data using modern analytics, reporting, AI, and Microsoft-based data solutions.

Job Summary

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) – Fresche Analytics, you will be a crucial member of our sales team, responsible for generating qualified leads and building a strong pipeline of Analytics opportunities.

A key focus of this role will be engaging CFOs, Finance leaders, FP&A teams, Controllers, and other business stakeholders who can benefit from improved financial reporting, analytics, and access to enterprise data.

Your primary goal will be to proactively identify target accounts, engage key decision-makers, qualify potential opportunities, and schedule high-quality introductory meetings for the Analytics sales team.

Responsibilities

Proactive Prospecting

  • Identify and research potential clients and target accounts for Fresche Analytics solutions.
  • Identify key decision-makers including CFOs, Finance leaders, FP&A teams, Controllers, and Analytics leaders.
  • Utilize prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and industry databases to build targeted prospect lists.

Outreach & Engagement

  • Conduct outbound outreach through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to generate interest in Fresche Analytics.
  • Clearly articulate how analytics solutions can improve financial reporting, business intelligence, data visibility, and decision-making.
  • Tailor outreach based on the prospect’s industry, business challenges, role, and existing technology environment.

Lead Qualification

  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand the prospect’s current reporting, analytics, and data environment.
  • Identify challenges such as manual reporting, spreadsheet dependency, fragmented data, limited visibility, or inefficient financial reporting processes.
  • Determine whether prospects have a potential need for Fresche Analytics solutions.
  • Accurately document qualification information within Salesforce and sales engagement platforms.

Meeting Scheduling

  • Schedule qualified introductory meetings between potential clients and the Analytics sales team.
  • Provide clear context regarding the prospect’s challenges, business priorities, stakeholders, and potential opportunity.
  • Ensure a smooth handoff of qualified opportunities to Account Executives.

Pipeline Generation

  • Consistently generate qualified Analytics leads and opportunities.
  • Build relationships with new Finance and business stakeholders within target accounts.
  • Track and report on lead generation activities, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline generated.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to refine Analytics-focused outbound campaigns and messaging.

CRM Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospecting activities and interactions within Salesforce.
  • Track progress against activity, meeting, opportunity, and pipeline targets.
  • Maintain accurate account and contact information to support ongoing prospecting efforts.

Market Knowledge

  • Develop a strong understanding of the Data & Analytics landscape, including financial analytics, business intelligence, reporting, AI, and modern data platforms.
  • Stay informed about Fresche Analytics solutions, customer use cases, and value propositions.
  • Develop an understanding of the business challenges facing CFOs and Finance organizations.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Analytics Account Executives to identify priority accounts and generate qualified opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on targeted Analytics and Finance-focused campaigns.
  • Share feedback on prospect objections, messaging effectiveness, market trends, and customer pain points.

Targets & Metrics

  • Consistent outbound prospecting activity across phone, email, and LinkedIn.
  • Qualified Meetings: Generate approximately 8–12 qualified Analytics meetings per month.
  • Pipeline Generation: Consistently contribute qualified pipeline for Fresche Analytics.
  • Account Penetration: Build new relationships with Finance and business stakeholders within targeted accounts.
  • Track meeting conversion, opportunity creation, pipeline generated, and overall campaign effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of success in a BDR, SDR, inside sales, or business development role, preferably within technology, analytics, SaaS, or IT services.
  • Experience prospecting into senior business stakeholders; experience engaging CFOs or Finance leaders is an asset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong phone presence and ability to engage senior decision-makers effectively.
  • Ability to understand and articulate analytics and technology concepts in a clear, business-focused manner.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM and prospecting tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesloft, Outreach, or similar platforms.
  • Experience or familiarity with analytics, financial reporting, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data, or related technologies is considered an asset.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and performance-based commission structure.
  • Premium benefits package.
  • Advanced sales tools and resources with a company-provided technology stack.
  • A culture of innovation and collaborative teams driven by client success.
  • Fully remote environment with occasional US and Canadian travel as required.
  • The opportunity to play a direct role in building and scaling Fresche’s growing Analytics business.

If you’re passionate about business development, analytics, and creating new relationships with business leaders, we’d like to hear from you.

raw.description:
Job Purpose / The Role

PortmanDentex is recruiting two Category Manager roles, each responsible for a key clinical growth category: Implants and Clear Aligners. The roles share the same remit and responsibilities, with each individual focusing on driving growth and performance within their specific category.

Reporting to the Commercial Director, the Category Manager will own the strategic growth, commercial performance and development of their category across the PortmanDentex practice network.

You will be responsible for driving the strategic growth of the Implants or Clear Aligner category across PortmanDentex, covering growth initiatives, supplier partnerships, commercial performance, clinical engagement and marketing initiatives. The role combines category strategy with hands-on delivery to ensure scalable, ethical and commercially sound implementation across the business.

You will be comfortable operating at all levels of the organisation - from nurses and Practice Managers through to Directors, clinicians and cross-functional teams - to implement best practices, optimise profitability, and enhance patient experience and clinical outcomes across our practices.

Working closely with Regional Clinical Leads (RCLs), clinicians, practice teams and central support functions, the Category Manager will lead the development and implementation of scalable category initiatives, treatment pathways and operational workflows that support consistent delivery across the network.

This role is well suited to an individual with strong category or programme management experience, ideally gained within a structured or blue-chip commercial environment, who is looking to apply their skills within a growing healthcare organisation. Travel across the UK and Ireland will be required.

Key Accountabilities

Category Strategy & Growth

  • Own the category strategy, growth roadmap and performance for either the Implants or Clear Aligner category across the PortmanDentex network.
  • Identify and prioritise opportunities to grow patient demand, treatment uptake and clinical utilisation.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clear commercial initiatives and implementation plans across practices.
  • Act as the internal category expert, providing insight and guidance to senior stakeholders across the business.

Implementation & Practice Engagement

  • Work closely with Regional Clinical Leads (RCLs), clinical SMEs and practice teams to support implementation of category initiatives.
  • Develop practical implementation plans that support consistent adoption of treatments, technologies and pathways across practices.
  • Engage clinicians and practice teams to share best practice and support capability development.

Supplier & Strategic Partner Management

  • Develop and manage strategic supplier partnerships that support category innovation, capability development and commercial growth.
  • Work with procurement to maximise value, training support and practice adoption from supplier relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce new technologies, treatment solutions and service models that enhance the patient offering.

Workflow Design & Adoption

  • Drive the development of scalable clinical and operational workflows to support the consistent delivery of implant or clear aligner treatments.
  • Support adoption planning, training and engagement across practices.

Performance & Insight

  • Monitor category performance across the network, identifying trends, performance gaps and opportunities for growth.
  • Use data and insight to inform commercial decision-making and prioritise improvement initiatives.
  • Track delivery metrics and benefits realisation to ensure category initiatives deliver measurable impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Operations, Marketing, BI, Procurement and Clinical teams to deliver initiatives that support category performance.
  • Support marketing campaigns, training initiatives and reporting frameworks that drive patient engagement and category growth.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (Business, Commerce, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Life Sciences / Health Sciences).
  • At least 12 months experience in category management, programme management or commercial project delivery, ideally within a structured or blue-chip organisation.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver cross-functional initiatives and drive implementation across multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clinicians, operational teams and senior leaders.
  • Strong commercial awareness and analytical capability, with the ability to interpret data and drive performance improvement.
  • Excellent communication, organisation and delivery skills.

Desired

  • Exposure to the healthcare, dental or medical device sector.
  • Experience supporting the development of service lines, treatment pathways or healthcare categories.
  • Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI).
  • Experience working within multi-site service or healthcare environments.
  • Experience working with premium, clinically led services or high-value treatment pathways.
  • Understanding of implant or orthodontic treatment pathways and technologies.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

  • A clear category growth strategy and delivery roadmap established and agreed with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong engagement with clinicians, Regional Clinical Leads and practice teams across the network.
  • Tangible improvements in category performance, treatment uptake and patient access.
  • Effective supplier partnerships delivering innovation, training and commercial value.
  • Scalable treatment pathways and operational workflows successfully implemented across practices.
  • Clear performance reporting and insight frameworks in place to support ongoing category development.

In addition to a competitive basic salary, our benefits also include:

  • Wellbeing Support: 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme and GP service plus an in-house Mental Health First Aider programme
  • Additional Reward: bonus scheme based on business performance, with additional bonus available linked to category growth
  • Extra Leave: Birthday off and option to buy 3 more days
  • Family Support: Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
  • Financial Security: Life assurance and pension scheme

Application process

When you click apply, we’ll need your CV and contact details, along with the answer to four quick questions and your application will be complete! You’ll get a response as quickly as we can, whatever the outcome of your application. As a heads up, we're planning to run the first stage interviews w/c 7 April.

Ready to join us? Click apply to take the next step in your career.

About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Director of Communications who can seamlessly navigate the intersection of cutting-edge technology, consumer trust, and public policy. This role is based remotely in the United States and will serve as the storyteller and strategic communications architect for Wing.

Wing is entering a new chapter of commercial maturity, moving from targeted drone delivery in key markets to scaling everyday delivery. As the leader in residential on-demand delivery, we are accelerating our rollout nationwide across 20 metro areas. In this role, you’ll architect an integrated communications strategy that transforms drone delivery from a futuristic novelty into an indispensable, trusted everyday service. Success requires a strategist who can balance the distinct needs of external media, local communities, local and federal regulators, global enterprise partners, and our expanding global workforce.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design a holistic internal and external communications strategy to support Wing's expansion into complex metropolitan markets.
  • Normalize drone delivery for consumers, shaping future behavior without losing the innovative factor of our service.
  • Drive B2B and B2C communications to ensure restaurant and retail partners recognize Wing as a viable, present-day delivery option worth prioritizing on their roadmaps.
  • Partner with the Government and Affairs and Public Policy teams to engage with federal aviation authorities, policymakers, and local municipal governments to navigate complex regulatory landscapes and community concerns regarding noise, privacy, and airspace safety.
  • Oversee comprehensive executive communications, thought leadership, internal communications, and crisis communications frameworks.
  • Distill highly complex autonomous technology into compelling, authentic stories that resonate with consumers, partners. policymakers, tech press, and employees.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing communications team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence across internal, external, policy, and product disciplines.

What You’ll Need:

  • 20+ years of experience in strategic communications, public relations, or corporate affairs, ideally within scaled environments within consumer brands
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Policy, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing reputational risk and building corporate narratives for a company undergoing rapid commercial scaling or regulatory scrutiny.
  • Proven track record of managing multifaceted communications teams across internal, external, product, and policy disciplines.
  • Exceptional executive presence and experience advising C-suite leadership on thought leadership and crisis management.

The mission of the Senior Director, Data & Analytics is to build the data foundation and analytical engine that powers every major decision at Curology — from how we acquire and retain patients to how we deliver personalized, science-backed care at scale. Reporting to [TBD] (with the reporting structure expected to evolve as the organization continues to grow), this role owns Curology's data infrastructure, architecture, and customer data platform, and leads a team spanning analytics, experimentation, and data science to turn subscriber and clinical data into decisions the business can act on.

Success in this role means using peripheral vision to connect data strategy to broader business outcomes across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Clinical, and Finance, and translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous, testable models. The Senior Director thinks in systems, governance, experimentation, and enterprise decision-making — balancing an ambitious data roadmap with sound judgment about what the business actually needs to trust and act on.

Essential Functions and Impact Areas

Data Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and execute the enterprise data strategy for Curology, aligning insights and models with enterprise-wide goals in growth, retention, patient care, and profitability.
  • Own and evolve the data stack, including pipelines, tooling, and architecture, ensuring reliability, scalability, and accessibility.
  • Guide the design and implementation of scalable data infrastructure in collaboration with Engineering to prioritize performance, advanced analytics, and security.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure scalable, secure, and accessible data infrastructure that supports advanced analytics and self-serve needs.

Customer Data Platform & Personalization

  • Lead ongoing development and governance of the customer data platform, aligning platform capabilities with personalization, compliance, and marketing needs.
  • Develop predictive and prescriptive models that support lifecycle marketing, personalization, retention optimization, and LTV forecasting.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of analysts and data scientists, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a thought leader and culture carrier, promoting data fluency and analytical thinking across all levels of the company.

Experimentation & Decision Support

  • Advance experimentation capabilities by formalizing test-and-learn methodologies and driving rigor in experiment design, execution, and analysis.
  • Establish executive dashboards and KPI frameworks that provide visibility into business health and performance across key domains.
  • Understand and evaluate AI-generated data, ensuring model outputs are interpretable, accurate, and actionable for business decision-making across product, marketing, and patient experience.

Governance, Compliance & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Own efforts for data quality, governance, and PII compliance in coordination with Legal and Engineering to ensure integrity in both day-to-day decisions and long-term modeling.
  • Partner closely with executive leadership, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Operations to identify high-leverage opportunities and deliver analytics that inform strategic decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven ownership of modern data stack, including pipelines, orchestration, and data warehouse platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery).
  • Mastery of modern analytics tools and programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, dbt, Looker, Tableau).
  • Strong grasp of experimental design, cohort analysis, predictive modeling, attribution methodologies, and growth diagnostics.
  • Proven ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, comfortable building executive narratives and jumping into datasets when needed.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to translate complexity into clarity for non-technical audiences.
  • High integrity, low ego, and a builder's mindset. You are focused on what drives results for the business and the team.
  • Working familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) and demonstrated strong judgment applying them to analytics work such as modeling, reporting, and executive narratives, with accountability for reviewing and validating outputs before use.

Location

Remote (US)

Our commitment to our people has earned us numerous awards including Inc5000's Fastest Growing Companies and Glassdoor's Best Places to Work. Explore what our employees have to say about our unique culture by clicking here.

By joining our rapidly growing Business Transformation practice you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. As a Manager at CrossCountry Consulting, you’ll bring your first-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to deliver tailored integrated solutions that help our clients solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. You will be responsible for a mix of client delivery, leading teams and developing junior team members, while assisting helping CFOs rebuild how planning, forecasting, close, and consolidation actually work and then activate that design through the platforms that run it.

We do both the strategy and the execution: operating model design, process reinvention, platform selection, implementation enablement, and hands-on FP&A support when clients need it most.

    • Lead client workshops grounded in diagnostic assessments to align stakeholders, facilitate current- and future-state design, and build consensus around transformation decisions across people, process, data, and technology. Develop strategic blueprints, target operating models, and multi-year transformation roadmaps that sequence near-term wins against structural and strategic changes

    • Provide strategic FP&A surge and interim support when needed, using hands-on exposure to identify process, operating model, and performance improvement opportunities and translate observations into actionable recommendations.

    EPM Technology Enablement

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Catalog Operations team powers the data that makes shopping effortless. Catalog data represents the vast majority of what customers see when they browse, search, and buy. Our quality, coverage, and accuracy directly shape the customer experience. We are an AI-first operations team that builds LLM-driven pipelines and scalable quality programs to create, enrich, and govern product data across the Instacart ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Catalog Operations Analyst II to accelerate our Health and Meals pillar within Online Grocery, one of our top strategic priorities. In this role, you will drive end-to-end data quality and enrichment for health, nutrition, and meal-related attributes, partnering closely with Catalog Engineering, Data Science, Product, and ML, as well as external data providers and BPOs. You’ll join a tight-knit team of 8 who roll up their sleeves, solve creatively, and deliver measurable impact at scale.

This role is based in Canada and is remote-eligible nationwide, with a preference for candidates located in Ontario (ideally Greater Toronto Area) for periodic in-person collaboration.

About the Job

  • Own data quality outcomes for the Health and Meals pillar by defining accuracy and coverage goals for critical attributes (e.g., nutrition, dietary tags, allergens, preparation/meal context) and driving measurable improvements across the catalog.
  • Design, test, and operationalize LLM pipelines in partnership with Catalog Engineering and ML, including prompt iterations, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop QA.
  • Develop robust SQL analyses to monitor health of the catalog, identify root causes, prioritize fixes, and communicate performance and impact to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Establish and continuously refine taxonomies, attribute definitions, and normalization standards; author SOPs and quality guidelines that scale across internal teams, external content providers, and BPOs.
  • Manage day-to-day execution with external vendors and data partners (e.g. BPOs), setting SLAs, creating QA workflows, and implementing sampling plans that improve precision and recall at scale.
  • Partner with Product, DS, and XFN teams to scope experiments, validate assumptions, and translate insights into roadmaps that elevate discovery, search relevance, and conversion for health and meal oriented use cases.

This is a fast-paced, evolving environment. You’ll thrive if you enjoy ambiguity, take ownership from problem definition through execution, and communicate clearly to align diverse partners on outcomes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in catalog/content operations, data operations, or data quality within e-commerce, marketplace, retail, or a similar high-scale data environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, or related field (e.g., Data/Information Science, Business, Economics, Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Data Science, and Product to scope requirements and deliver production-scale projects.
  • Proficiency in SQL (including joins, aggregations, and window functions) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets for analysis, QA sampling, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and prompt design for data extraction, classification, or attribute enrichment, including LLM evaluation and feedback loops.
  • Hands-on experience defining and managing data quality metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall) and running root cause analyses.
  • Experience operationalizing workflows with external vendors/BPOs or data providers, including SOPs, SLAs, and multi-step QA processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) in your day to day.
  • Experience with data wrangling, QA automation, and scaling manual processes.
  • Experience building dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or Mode to track operational and quality KPIs.
  • Track record of delivering results in dynamic, ambiguous environments while communicating effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Background in ecommerce, grocery/CPG data, or technology/startups.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

Aireon deployed the world’s first global space-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real-time aircraft monitoring capabilities around the world, including over the poles, over the oceans and in remote areas.
Aireon data enables safer, more efficient and more environmentally friendly aviation travel, resulting in significant CO2 emission reductions. More than 20 Air Navigation Service Providers representing more than 40 countries – including NAV CANADA, NATS (UK), Air Traffic and Navigation Services (South Africa), Airports Authority of India (AAI), and ASECNA (Africa) -- rely on Aireon data to navigate aircraft in their airspaces.
We are committed to offering an employment experience and benefits package that enables you and your family to grow with us and to share in our success.

Position Summary, Job Requirements & Responsibilities

As Sales Manager APAC for the Aireon Commercial Data Services team, you will be responsible for identifying and nurturing new leads, driving opportunities through our sales pipeline to successful conversion, and managing relationships with customers and prospects across a diverse and dynamic region. Leveraging your established network and deep understanding of the APAC aviation landscape, you will represent Aireon internationally at relevant industry events and forums, and provide key market insights back into the organization to ensure that Aireon's products and services remain at the forefront of the global flight tracking industry.

What You’ll Do

Sales Leadership
  • Lead the presentation of Aireon's ADS-B data services to new prospects and drive qualified Commercial Data Services (CDS) opportunities confidently and efficiently through the sales pipeline
  • Actively seek out and nurture new CDS leads to ensure a constant flow of active opportunities that align with organizational objectives
  • Measure and regularly present the performance of opportunities and accounts via key metrics
  • Identify opportunities to expand new data services to existing clients
  • Actively identify opportunities to create case studies and other marketing material based on closed deals, to showcase Aireon's services and inspire further growth via market proof
Excellent Customer Relationship Management
  • Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with key prospects and industry contacts across the APAC region
  • Act as the primary point of contact for top-tier accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction via responsive and knowledgeable communication and active problem solving
  • Negotiate contracts, develop and manage client-specific pricing strategies, and drive renewals to maximize profitability
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the content and structure of key client contracts and associated commercial arrangements
Display High Levels of Technical Expertise and Service Knowledge
  • Maintain a deep understanding of Aireon's ADS-B technology, data services, and applications
  • Provide technical insights to clients, successfully bridging the gap between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, engineering, operations, legal, and sales ops) to deliver comprehensive solutions to new key customer accounts
  • Keep up to date with new product developments — including the timeline of new releases and the content of new service offerings — and connect this knowledge to new sales opportunities
Guide Strategic Business Development
  • Work with the CDS Sales Director and BD Lead to identify and prioritize target markets, customer segments, and industries for ADS-B data sales across the APAC region
  • Monitor emerging trends, competitor activities, regulatory changes, and global aviation developments, and ensure feedback is shared with the product team to build and maintain Aireon's competitive edge
  • Collaborate with Product, Sales Ops, and Marketing teams to guide offerings and associated material to meet the needs of customers and wider industry expectations
  • Support and advocate for CDS products and services both internally and externally, contributing to a positive culture of open innovation and collaboration within and around the sales team
Industry Engagement and Representation
  • Professionally represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and industry events across the APAC region and beyond, to enhance visibility, grow our network, and generate leads

raw.title: Founder in Residence, Priming plant resilience for climate risks
raw.excerpt: Join us to build: we’re seeking entrepreneurially-minded individuals with deep technical and commercial domain expertise, who are eager to solve urgent unmet challenges through venture building.
raw.description:
Join us to build: we’re seeking entrepreneurially-minded individuals with deep technical and commercial domain expertise, who are eager to solve urgent unmet challenges through venture building. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of agtech, leading a company solving challenges of climate adaptation for food security and the wider bioeconomy.

The role is full-time, remoteinitially until venture incorporation and spin-out (circa end of Q2 2027), location TBD.

ABOUT DSV

Deep Science Ventures (DSV) is on a mission to create a future in which both humans and the planet can thrive. We use our unique venture creation process to create, spin-out, and invest in science companies, combining available scientific knowledge and founder-type scientists into high-impact ventures. Operating in four sectors—Pharmaceuticals, Climate, Agriculture, and Computation—we tackle the challenges defining these areas by taking a first principles approach and partnering with leading institutions.

OUR PARTNERSHIP WITH RENAISSANCE PHILANTHROPY

Driven by mutual conviction in the huge unmet need for driving a new category of agricultural technology: priming resilience in crops,DSV has partnered with Renaissance Philanthropy to accelerate the development of venture creation at the intersection of climate risk, plant biology, and deployable agricultural products.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join DSV’s venture creation programme as a Founder-in-Residence and work closely with the DSV and Renaissance Philanthropy team to spin out the new company. During the programme you will refine, improve and complement existing scoping work on:

  • The technical thesis for crop systems that can be primed for resilience in the face of increasingly unpredictable and severe climate pressures (neglect and technical tractability);
  • Commercial neglect (IP strategy, differentiation, competition);
  • Value proposition (market, value capture, techno-economics);
  • Regulatory strategy & positioning;
  • Fundraising strategy & pitching;
  • Optimising company strategy for the most rapid and de-risked path to Series A.

Preparation for Investment Committee (IC) will involve fulfilling our investment criteria, recruiting advisory and co-founding team members, and parallel fundraising for additional expansion funds.

Assuming success at IC, you will receive pre-seed investment and spinout the company by the end of Q2 2027. You and your co-founders will own a significant stake in the business and continue receiving support post-spinout.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Across global agriculture, climate volatility is no longer a ‘once-a-decade’ disruption - it is becoming an in-season operating condition. Drought and heatwaves are already driving severe regional harvest losses, with cascading impacts that reach far beyond the farm gate: price shocks, food insecurity, and destabilised livelihoods. Even where catastrophic crop failures are not occurring, the evidence base is clear that climate change is already depressing yields and amplifying climate-related production losses in major cropping systems.

Despite this reality, most crop resilience strategies remain anchored in a static view of risk. Today’s dominant approaches focus on breeding or engineering permanent stress tolerance into plants, or introducing permanent protective structures. While effective under chronic stress, these solutions come with an inherent trade-off: technologies that protect yield under adverse conditions present a burden when conditions are favourable. For many crops - particularly rain-fed cereals and broadacre systems - this ‘carrying cost’ is economically unacceptable. In practice, growers are left exposed to short, acute stress events (such as a brief heat spike during flowering or sudden water-logging after planting) that can irreversibly damage yield but do not justify permanent genetic or infrastructure compromises.

We believe this creates a compelling opportunity for a new paradigm: on-demand plant resilience. Instead of locking crops into a constant defensive state, plants could be temporarily primed to withstand stress only when risk is imminent - and then returned to a high-productivity mode once the threat passes. Advances across plant biology now make this vision increasingly plausible. Emerging tools such as RNA-based interventions, virus-enabled gene modulation, signalling peptides, and stress-responsive biologicals point toward the ability to transiently activate protective pathways, reprogram development, or stabilise yield-critical processes during vulnerable windows.

This approach has the potential to address not only extreme climate shocks, but also the everyday volatility that quietly erodes agricultural value: mistimed flowering, pre-harvest sprouting triggered by humidity, transient root-zone stress, or short droughts that reduce grain fill. Importantly, these interventions could be deployed in-season, aligned with weather forecasts or early stress signals, creating a more adaptive and responsive crop protection toolkit.

Commercially, this space remains wide open. Existing biostimulants and stress-mitigation products are often blunt, inconsistently effective, or poorly matched to specific climate risks. Meanwhile, large incumbents remain focused on conventional chemistry, genetics, or incremental biologicals, leaving little coordinated effort around truly inducible resilience platforms. At the same time, regulatory and technical signals show growing feasibility for novel biological and RNA-based crop inputs, while grower demand for tools that protect yield reliability under volatility continues to accelerate.

We are seeking a Founder in Residence to build a company at the intersection of climate risk, plant biology, and deployable agricultural products. The ambition is to create a platform that makes climate readiness a controllable, on-demand trait - integrating scientific insight, smart delivery, and clear grower ROI into a scalable venture capable of redefining how crops are protected in an unpredictable world.

Requirements

WHO SHOULD APPLY

Essential Values

  • You are highly motivated by unsolved challenges in climate risk mitigation, and driven to challenge the status quo in agriculture.
  • You are impact driven, take the initiative, make things happen, and think from a first principles perspective to figure out what’s really needed.
  • You have clear entrepreneurial spirit and mindset, demonstrated through impactful innovation, and an ability to work in ambiguous, unstructured but fast-paced, demanding and pressurised environments.
  • Collaborative nature, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Essential experience (must-have)

  • Core science depth (PhD or equivalent industry R&D know-how) in plant physiology, crop science, molecular biology, epigenetics, microbiology (or similar), with knowledge breadth across technological areas relevant for priming plant resilience such as:
    • Delivery systems for biologicals (e.g. nanoparticle design, encapsulation chemistry, triggered release mechanisms, protectant formulations);
    • Developmental regulation & priming (e.g. RNA / peptide-based modulators, epigenetic modification, heat shock pathways, hormone signalling);
    • Plant-microbiome engineering (e.g. symbiont characterisation, consortia design, engineered exudate production, host-microbe signalling);
    • Accelerated trait development & gene editing (e.g. tissue regeneration protocols, wild relative introgression, precision breeding pipelines);
    • Crop environment engineering (e.g. seed/root coating formulations, biodegradable matrices, water management at plant scale).
  • Translational execution: e.g. taking traits / actives from discovery to field, managing CRO/CDMO programs, building regulator / investor / customer-ready data packages; and / or partnership development (growers, CROs/CDMOs, suppliers) and scalable IP strategy.
  • Cross-functional ownership across: R&D - Product - Regulatory - IP, evidenced by shipped results (trial outcomes, submissions, patents, launches); and / or design of pivotal field trials.
  • Venture creation/fundraising; and/or product leadership in agtech / biotech or adjacent areas.

Equivalents considered: deep industry R&D in agtech / biotech or a PhD with applied field work and comparable outcomes.

Preferred experience (nice-to-have)

  • Previous Founder experience (in biotech).
  • Previous C-suite experience (in biotech).
  • Previous fundraising experience (VC).
  • Commercial & BD expertise incl. network in agrochem/pesticide development (licensing, partnering, collaborations).
  • Strong track record of building and leading successful teams.

Benefits

OUR OFFER

By joining DSV, you’ll be joining a team of operators who have founded companies and led translation of science at some of the most respected universities, charities, funds and government agencies. 2/3 of the team have founded or led a company at C-suite and 65% have a PhD. Our team dedicate several hours every week to each Founder or founding team to provide tailored guidance, resources and feedback covering every aspect of what it takes to successfully launch a new venture from both the tech and commercial perspectives:

  • We provide optimised, purpose-built, proprietary tools, resources and processes to help create high-impact ventures from scratch, using our venture creation methodology.
  • DSV and RenPhil's extensive network incl. leaders of biotech VCs, technical & commercial domain expertise, and wide-ranging portfolio company capabilities.
  • We jointly provide an initial £250k (~$340k / €290k) investment governed by our Investment Committee to incorporate the new venture and develop early proof-of-concept data that is often needed to attract high profile non-venture studio VCs. This funding is also key for obtaining grant funding, which often needs to be matched with private investment.
  • You and your co-founder(s) together will own the majority equity stake in the company.
  • We provide minimum guaranteed income of £4,166 per month (fixed), paid to each Founder as a consultancy fee until the company is launched and pre-seed investment is secured.
  • We provide continuous support post spin-out, including fundraising, commercial partnerships, recruitment and team-building (amongst other things).
  • Other Founders currently at DSV across sectors working collaboratively and supporting one another - a unique resource to draw on.

Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

As Stripe continues to develop innovative products that serve businesses of all sizes around the world, risk will increase in complexity and scale. The User Risk Strategy org protects and advances our business, brand, and mission by building and deploying market-leading policies and practices that instill user and partner trust in Stripe while enabling business growth.

What you'll do

Under the User Risk Strategy org, you'll be part of the Ecosystem Risk Strategy Team, part of our "First Line of Defense" function within the Risk organization, driving the frameworks that dictate who Stripe does business with, on what terms, and how enforcement is executed at scale. The Ecosystem Risk Strategy Team focuses on our positioning and standards within the broader payments and risk ecosystem — including card network supportability, industry-body engagement, regulatory horizon scanning, and the overarching risk framework that governs our standards. Risk Strategists on the Ecosystem Risk Strategy Team work to make sure the User Risk Strategy team is properly calibrated to ensure we avoid (and take) the proper risks. We work with cross-functional partners to monitor and mitigate risk related to card network rules and BIN sponsor requirements. We interact with Risk Partnerships, Credit, Legal, Fraud, and other cross-functional teams to ensure our standards are properly calibrated.

We're looking for someone who is passionate about navigating ambiguity, engaging with internal and external stakeholders, enabling business growth while balancing risk, and identifying ways to improve user experience.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

About Velixo
Velixo is an award-winning vendor of Excel-based reporting solutions for Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software, such as Acumatica, MYOB, Cegid and Sage Intacct. We serve customers of every size, in every industry, by enhancing their reporting and planning experience, and introducing a world of innovative features and integrations in the Excel they love.

Headquartered in Montreal, Canada, we are a diverse and fast-paced organization that is rapidly growing in revenue and personnel. Our team is spread out across the world to support a growing base strong of 1800+ customers and 200+ value-added resellers worldwide.

About the role:

We are looking for a passionate ERP Data Analyst to join our team at Velixo. As a ERP Data Analyst, you will be responsible for demonstrating product capabilities, analyzing business requirements and designing reporting solutions using SQL and Excel. Your expertise in Microsoft Excel, strong analytical mindset, and ability to provide valuable insights will play a crucial role in helping our customers leverage our Excel-based reporting solution for their ERP systems. This is an exciting opportunity to work in the ERP software industry and be part of a collaborative and growth-oriented team. We are considering candidates anywhere in Canada.

Responsibilities:

  • Attend product demonstrations with prospective customers, answer technical questions and demonstrate complex functionalities.

  • Create proof-of-concept to highlight Velixo capabilities to prospective customers.

  • Gather and analyse customer requirements, identify and solve roadblocks, estimate project scope and write specification documents.

  • Develop customer reports based on specification documents.

  • Provide initial support to new users, guiding them through the product’s features and troubleshooting common issues.

  • Conduct comprehensive training sessions for clients, partners and colleagues to ensure effective use of the product.

  • Develop training materials and documentation tailored to different user skill levels.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Velixo and the ERP systems that we integrate with. Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends in reporting techniques.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree in finance, accounting, computer science or engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software industry.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data-enhancement functions, dynamic arrays, filters, conditional formatting, pivot tables, lambdas, and data sources.

  • Strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex information to clients.

  • Working knowledge of SQL to manipulate and extract data.

  • Familiarity with financial reporting and accounting basics.

  • Experience working in an ERP system, particularly Acumatica or Sage Intacct, is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive benefits package, including health insurance, RRSP plan, vacation and personal days.

  • Financial support for professional development courses to enhance skills and knowledge.

  • Opportunity for career growth within a collaborative and supportive work environment.

At Velixo, we prioritize the growth and development of our employees, recognizing their potential and providing opportunities to excel in their chosen field. We are excited to welcome you to our team and embark on a journey of mutual success.

Come be a part of our mission and make a meaningful and positive impact with the industry leading provider of language services for the Deaf and hard-of-hearing!

Full time Benefits

  • 401k 6% match with immediate vesting

    • TeleDoc

Pay Range: Actual pay may vary up or down depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for incentive compensation.

* Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States to be considered. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role *

Job Summary

The Senior Director of AI Sign Translation Partnerships identifies, prioritizes, and grows relationships across four distinct partner categories - Services, ISV, Hardware, and Channel - that together will carry AST’s technology into enterprise and government accounts.

This is a 0-to-1 role: much of this ecosystem does not yet exist at AST. You will build the target lists, make the first calls, run the early conversations, and turn the strongest relationships into structured pilots, referral agreements, and co-sell motions. You’ll work closely with the VP of GTM to translate partner activity into pipeline and, over time, build out a small partnerships team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partner Segmentation & Targeting: Build and maintain a prioritized target list of partners across four categories, informed by AST’s ideal customer profile and product roadmap.
  • Category Coverage: Own outreach, relationship development, and pipeline for:
  • Services — GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte), SI/RSI/industry specialists (e.g., Slalom), accessibility consultants (e.g., Deque, New Editions), media services (e.g., ASG, Tata Communications), and translation services (e.g., U.S. Translation)
  • ISV — communications platforms (e.g., Zoom, Webex, Google Meet, Slack), LMS providers (e.g., Docebo, Blackboard), accessibility ISVs (e.g., accessiBe, AudioEye), media ISVs (e.g., Blackmagic, Grass Valley, Avid), and enterprise software platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, SAP)
  • Hardware — OEM hardware (e.g., Apple, Dell, HP), media hardware (e.g., DaVinci), and kiosk vendors (e.g., Nixdorf, NCR, Zebra, Micros)
  • Channel — resellers/VARs (e.g., SHI, TD-Synnex), distributors (e.g., CDW, Carahsoft), hyperscalers (e.g., AWS, Google, Microsoft), and government contractors (e.g., GSA)
  • Partner Development: Run structured discovery conversations with prospective partners, qualify fit, assess mutual value, and move the strongest relationships into pilots, referral arrangements, or joint go-to-market plans.
  • Commercial Structuring: Draft and negotiate partnership terms - referral fees, reseller agreements, co-sell frameworks, and integration commitments - in coordination with the VP of GTM and Legal.
  • Playbook & Enablement: Build repeatable playbooks per partner category (outreach templates, qualification criteria, onboarding steps, objection handling) as the ecosystem scales.
  • Pipeline & Reporting: Track partner pipeline, conversion, and pilot outcomes; report progress and category-level insights to the VP of GTM on a regular cadence.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Marketing to ensure partner commitments align with the roadmap, contracting standards, and brand.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Travel Requirements

Travel Requirements: 25-50%

Education

Minimum 4 Year / Bachelors Degree In a related field

Experience

6 years In partnerships, channel, or business development roles, with exposure to more than one type of partner motion (e.g., both channel/reseller and ISV/technology partnerships).

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Comfort with ambiguity: proven ability to build a partner program from scratch — target lists, outreach, and playbooks — rather than executing against an established one.
  • Multi-threaded execution: able to run parallel outreach and relationship-building motions across several distinct partner categories at once.
  • Commercial fluency: comfortable structuring referral, reseller, and co-sell agreements, and negotiating with partner counterparts at varying levels of seniority.
  • Executive presence: able to represent AST credibly with partner executives, while also being hands-on enough to run early-stage outreach personally.
  • Mission alignment: genuine interest in accessibility technology and its impact on the Deaf and Hard-of-hearing community.
  • Relevant industry exposure a plus: accessibility, enterprise collaboration/ communications software, media technology, or public sector/government channel experience.

Company Summary

Our Mission…Harnessing the power of language, we connect diverse people and enrich the human experience.

Our Vision…To provide global language services that expand opportunities, nurture belonging, and empower the world to connect beyond words.

As one of the world’s leading language services providers, Sorenson combines patented technology with human-centric solutions. We strive to increase accessibility and inclusion through communication solutions for all: call captioning and video relay services, over-video and in-person sign language and spoken language interpreting, translation, real-time captioning, and post-production language services. Sorenson’s impact vision and plan extends to enhancing generational wealth and inclusive workplaces for our employees and the communities we serve.

We achieve great things together working “The Sorenson Way” with our employee values: Customer First, Can-Do Attitude, Collective Action, Growth Mindset, Ownership, and Connect Direct.

Sorenson Communications is an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action Employer.
